name: shrinkage-price
title: How much to shrink
idea: The prior SD is set or estimated by the producer: over many draws the distance to the true values is smallest near the true spread (prior centered on their average), and the pair probabilities postrank reads move with it.
from: new angle · builds on v1 L-04 view 2; adds curves over the whole prior-SD range: the distance to the true values (with its closed-form expectation) and what postrank reads from the posterior, its pair probabilities (how many directions are near certain); the report and the share it claims are 2.9's
credit: Built for this site; normal-normal shrinkage after Walters, Mixtape slides p. 27; a producer's hyperparameters and a fixed-parameter experiment, after the postrank theory book, ch. 18.
caption: The posterior is calculated from the chosen normal prior and the estimates with their standard errors.
